gastro.metaTitle: Restaurant Software – Your Own Ordering System, Zero Commission
gastro.metaDescription: Your own ordering system, reservations and kitchen dashboard for restaurants, takeaways, bakeries and delivery services. No platform commission, from €3,900.

hero.text: Your own ordering system, reservations and kitchen board – under your name, with no commission per order. For restaurants, takeaways, bakeries, cafés and delivery services.
hero.imageAlt: Ordering system of Daron Brot II bakery in Aachen

stats.label: DE · EN · AR in the live project

problem.title: Every regular's order costs you commission.
problem.text: Delivery platforms bring new guests – and then take a cut of every order after that. They keep the customer data, and your brand disappears among a hundred others. Your own system brings back margin, data and the relationship.
points: Commission even on regulars who already know you
No customer data for offers, loyalty rewards or lunch menus
Orders on three tablets, reservations on the phone
Menu on the website out of date, prices nowhere in one place

features.title: Online ordering
features.text: Menu with variants, extras and allergens. Pickup and delivery with zones and minimum order value.

features.title: Kitchen board
features.text: New orders with a chime on the tablet, status with one tap, cancellations with a reason.

features.title: Online payment
features.text: Card, PayPal, Apple Pay and Google Pay – the money goes straight to you.

features.title: Reservations
features.text: Let guests book tables online, with confirmation and reminders by email or WhatsApp.

features.title: Dashboard & numbers
features.text: Revenue per hour, top items, share of direct orders – at a glance.

features.title: Multilingual
features.text: Menu and ordering in German, English, Arabic or Turkish – for every guest.

faq.q: Do I have to cancel Lieferando or Wolt?
faq.a: No. Most businesses run both: the platform for new guests, your own system for everyone who comes back.

faq.q: How much does an ordering system cost?
faq.a: From €3,900 one-off to start, with online payment and kitchen display from €6,900. Operations from €49 per month.

faq.q: How fast can it go live?
faq.a: You'll see the clickable prototype after about seven days; most systems go live after three to four weeks.

faq.q: Can I change prices and items myself?
faq.a: Yes. You change prices, items, opening hours and sold-out status in the dashboard.

faq.q: Do you also shoot food photos and reels?
faq.a: Yes – that's where we come from. Food reels and photos are available on top of the system, so the menu actually sells.

faq.q: How much does a student app cost?

faq.q: Do you also make vehicle videos?

privacy.draft: Draft – describes the technical data flows of this website. Have it legally reviewed before going live.
privacy.formsText: When you contact us via the funnel or the pricing calculator, we store your details (name, email, optionally phone, company, message, selected services, budget range and calculation) to process your enquiry (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR). The data is stored in a Supabase database (hosted in the EU, Frankfurt region) and processed via a self-hosted n8n workflow: a notification to us and a confirmation email to you. We only store your IP address as a salted hash to protect against spam. If no contract results, we delete enquiries after 24 months at the latest.
privacy.calendlyText: We only load the booking calendar after you click. Data is then transferred to Calendly LLC (USA) (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR, EU-US Data Privacy Framework).
privacy.videosText: Preview clips are hosted on our own server. Links to YouTube only open in a new tab when you click them.
privacy.rightsText: Access, rectification, erasure, restriction, data portability and objection – a quick email to us is all it takes.
